payout_quote: The person making the referral (Referrer) may earn a $50 Visa Virtual Reward for each Referred Person referred to Wings Financial Credit Union who registers, becomes a member, opens a new Wings Financial Checking Account, and completes the following requirements within 60 days of account opening. The Referred Person may earn a $50 Visa Virtual Reward.
steps: Be a current Wings Financial Credit Union member in good standing (18+) and register for the referral program to share the offer.
Share your referral link with friends; they must register before opening the account (referral good for 180 days).
Your friend qualifies for membership, opens a $5 Share Savings account and a new Wings Financial Checking Account.
Within 60 days of account opening, your friend sets up eDocuments AND completes either one direct deposit of $300+ or five debit card transactions of $5+ each (ATM excluded).
Your $50 Visa Virtual Reward is emailed to your registration email address within 2-3 weeks after all requirements are completed.
catches: The $50 is a Visa Virtual Reward (usable only at online/mail/telephone merchants where Visa debit is accepted) - not cash; valid 6 months from issuance.
Cap: $550 per calendar year for qualified referrals (11 referrals).
Friend must be a genuine newcomer: never had a membership at Wings Financial Credit Union.
Gig-economy/self-employment income does not count as direct deposit.
The referrer must be a current member - if not, no rewards are sent to either party.
Referrer cannot be joint or cosigner on the referred member's account; employees ineligible.
Reward amounts may be reported to tax authorities; recipient responsible for taxes.
Wings reserves the right to refuse payment of the reward in its sole discretion.
biggest_catch: Your $50 comes as a virtual Visa card (online/phone purchases only, expires in 6 months) - and your friend must be a brand-new member who sets up eDocuments plus a $300 direct deposit or 5 debit transactions within 60 days.
eligibility: Current Wings Financial CU members 18+ in good standing. Referred person must never have had a Wings Financial membership, be 18+, and qualify for membership ($5 Share Savings).
timing: Virtual reward emailed within 2-3 weeks after all requirements are completed.
